title: Semrush Keyword Suggestions Scraper
description: Expand seed keywords into Semrush suggestion phrases. Batch multiple queries to build topic lists for SEO briefs and content research.

batch.title: Seed keywords
batch.description: Keywords to expand with Semrush suggestions.
batch.valueDescription: Seed phrase used to request keyword ideas.

schema.description: Search Query sent to the source search.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Get Semrush keyword suggestions for seed phrases. Batch queries to find related terms and export ideas for SEO briefs and content research plans.
storeCopy.intro: Expand Semrush seed phrases into related keyword ideas. Each suggestion is saved as a row with the original query so you can compare topics and export a search plan.
useCases: SEO writers can expand target terms into related phrases for briefs.
Search marketers can compare keyword ideas across product categories.
Content strategists can build topic lists from a set of seed queries.
howToUse: Set `maxResults` to limit the total suggestions saved for the run.
Group exported suggestions by `input_q` to retain their source phrase.

faqs.question: Does the Actor include search volume?
faqs.answer: No. This endpoint returns suggestion phrases; it does not provide keyword volume metrics.

fields.name: value

fields.name: input_q
fields.description: Seed keyword submitted to Semrush to retrieve related suggestions.
